verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted API with client SDKs, since SDKs or the console could collect usage data. The evidence never mentions SDK telemetry, analytics tracking, or any opt-out setting or environment variable. The closest items are a no-training-on-customer-data statement and enterprise-only zero data retention; both cover data handling, not opting out of telemetry or usage tracking.
